## Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear description of the problem. (e.g. "I'm frustrated when I can't ...")

## Proposed solution
A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional context
Screenshots, mockups, links to related issues, or MCP integrations that would be involved.

## Local-first check
Does this feature require sending data off-machine? If so, how should it remain
optional / opt-in, consistent with Research Core's local-first ethos?
